name: get_application_status
description: Look up the current status, stage history, police verification mode and Speed Post number of the signed-in applicant's passport application. Both the 15-character file number and the applicant's date of birth are required, and the date of birth must match the application. If it does not match, tell the user you cannot share the status. Do not reveal any part of the record, and do not guess.

fileNo.description: 15-character passport file number issued at the PSK, e.g. DL1069210456726

dob.description: Applicant's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: get_appointment
description: Look up a PSK/POPSK appointment of the signed-in applicant by Application Reference Number (ARN). Returns the service, centre, date, time, status and the reschedules used and allowed.

name: get_police_verification
description: Look up police verification for the signed-in applicant's passport file: the mode (pre, post or none), police station, initiation date, current status and result.
